$comment: Community display names for guild-war board ids used by the vendored GlobalConfig. Boards shuffle across zones between battles; the name follows the board, not the zone.

preloadedButNeverPooled.$comment: Present in GlobalConfig guildWar.boardsToInclude (asset preload superset) but absent from EVERY season config's mapPool — never playable, hence no community name exists. Verified 2026-08-10 across all 10 season configs.
